title: Implement semantic versioning for nixDir
description: Add automated semantic versioning using git-cliff and Nix scripts. Multi-branch model: main→v1.x.y, v3→v3.x.y, etc. Consumers use branch for latest (github:user/nixDir/v3) or tag for pinned (github:user/nixDir/v3.2.1).
design:
## Approach
- git-cliff for changelog generation from conventional commits
- Nix scripts (writeShellApplication) for CI logic - locally testable
- GitHub Actions as thin wrapper calling `nix run .#release`
- Git tags only (no GitHub Releases page)

## Files to Create
1. cliff.toml - git-cliff configuration
2. nix/packages/scripts/calculate-version.nix - version calculation
3. nix/packages/scripts/generate-changelog.nix - changelog generation  
4. nix/packages/scripts/release.nix - full release workflow
5. nix/packages/scripts/default.nix - export scripts
6. .github/workflows/release.yml - CI wrapper

## Files to Modify
- flake.nix - expose scripts as packages

## Version Bump Rules
- feat: → minor bump (3.1.0 → 3.2.0)
- fix:, docs:, chore:, etc. → patch bump (3.1.0 → 3.1.1)
- Major bumps (v3 → v4): manual branch creation
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] cliff.toml configured for conventional commits
- [ ] nix run .#calculate-version shows next version
- [ ] nix run .#generate-changelog creates CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] nix run .#release creates commit + tag locally
- [ ] GitHub Actions workflow triggers on v3/main push
- [ ] First release creates v3.0.0 tag
close_reason: Implemented semantic versioning with git-cliff and Nix scripts. All acceptance criteria met.

title: Add passFlakeInputs option to nixDir
description: Add a global option nixDir.passFlakeInputs that makes all files in the main nix/ directory receive flake inputs as the first parameter (like with-inputs/ behavior). This simplifies setup for projects that don't need portability.
design:
## Approach
Conditionally use *WithInputs importer variants based on new cfg.passFlakeInputs option.

## Files to Modify
1. default.nix - Add option definition + conditional imports in all addXxx functions
2. README.md - Document new option
3. docs/with-inputs.md - Add "Global Inputs Mode" section with usage guidance

## Implementation Pattern
For each addXxx function, change:
```nix
regularModules = if pathExists then importer.importXxx path else {};
```
To:
```nix
regularModules = if pathExists then
  (if cfg.passFlakeInputs then importer.importXxxWithInputs else importer.importXxx) path
else {};
```

## Functions to Update (8 total)
- addNixOSModules (line 121)
- addNixOSConfigurations (line 144)
- addNixDarwinModules (line 171)
- addNixDarwinConfigurations (line 196)
- addHomeManagerModules (line 223)
- addDevenvModules (line 251)
- addPackages (perSystem, line 302)
- addDevShellsAndDevenvs (lines 372, 388)
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Option nixDir.passFlakeInputs defined with boolean type, default false
- [ ] Option description includes recommendation and when-to-use guidance
- [ ] All 8 addXxx functions conditionally use WithInputs variants
- [ ] with-inputs/ directory continues to work alongside passFlakeInputs
- [ ] README.md lists the new option
- [ ] docs/with-inputs.md has "Global Inputs Mode" section
